mostWorthwhile.text: Following fungi from breaking down wood to supporting new growth made nutrient cycling concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Creating a storm felt like a slow opening because its connection to the goals was initially unclear, although the result explained it.

surprise.text: Forest transpiration can contribute to rainfall far downwind, extending the story beyond decomposition.

arbitrary.text: Combining partnered cells with fallen wood to produce fungi felt somewhat abstract; the explanation clarified that it represented evolution, not wood turning into fungi.

continue.text: Yes. The contrasting paths of decomposition and peat formation made me curious about how later chapters might connect ecological processes.
